reasons: Directionally correct for the Customer (Sparkling): notice for our convenience termination is cut from 90 to 30 days, matching the preferred position, and the wind-down/certification timing is conformed consistently.

The added sentence supplies the two missing preferred-position elements — no termination charge/early-termination fee and a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees — using language close to the model clause, with no expansion of Garman's rights.

The failed deterministic check 'Customer convenience termination present' appears to be a phrasing-match artifact; the revised text expressly states 'Sparkling may terminate this Agreement, in whole or in part, at any time for convenience upon thirty (30) calendar days written notice', so the substance is satisfied. The 0.434 changed-character ratio is justified by the required refund/no-penalty addition.
Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural, correctly cites the playbook position, and offers the 60-day notice fallback conditioned on retaining the refund.

Rationale correctly recognises that Garman has no reciprocal at-will right (Section 17(c) limited to insolvency/uncured default), so no deletion of a Vendor convenience right is needed and the edit remains the smallest change reaching the preferred position.
